status_summary: Bills to repeal the charter were introduced on 2025-07-16: H.R. 4450 (Rep. Mark Harris, referred to the House Judiciary Committee) and S. 2310 (Sen. Marsha Blackburn with Sen. Cynthia Lummis, referred to the Senate Judiciary Committee), each titled the National Education Association Charter Repeal Act; the House text repeals chapter 1511 of title 36, U.S. Code. The govinfo.gov bill status records show 20 cosponsors on H.R. 4450 (14 original, the last added 2025-12-09) and no action after referral on either bill. The House Education and Workforce Committee wrote to the NEA on 2025-09-29 opening an inquiry into its retirement program, with documents due 2025-10-13; that letter concerns member retirement products and not federal funds, and no hearing on NEA use of federal money was found.

timeline.event: H.R. 4450, the National Education Association Charter Repeal Act, was introduced by Rep. Mark Harris with 14 cosponsors and referred to the House Judiciary Committee; it would repeal chapter 1511 of title 36, U.S. Code.
S. 2310, the Senate companion, was introduced by Sen. Marsha Blackburn for herself and Sen. Cynthia Lummis and referred to the Senate Judiciary Committee.
The House Education and Workforce Committee majority wrote to the NEA president opening an investigation of the NEA's retirement program and requested documents by 2025-10-13.
